featured.title: Which decade is your personality from?
featured.description: A playful quiz that reads you better than your friends do.
featured.promptText: Ask me 10 quick questions, one at a time. Then tell me which decade my personality belongs in, and explain why with a bit of humor.

trending.title: Turn yourself into a renaissance portrait
trending.description: The classic. Works in any image generator.
trending.promptText: A renaissance oil painting portrait of [describe yourself], dramatic candlelight, rich fabrics, ornate gold frame, museum quality.

trending.title: Your day as a movie trailer
trending.description: Make your Tuesday sound like a blockbuster.
trending.promptText: Write a dramatic movie trailer voiceover script about my ordinary day. I will describe my day, you make it sound epic.

trending.title: The dinner party test
trending.description: Five guests, living or dead. What do your picks say about you?
trending.promptText: Ask me to pick 5 dinner guests, living or dead. Then analyze what my choices say about my personality.

trending.title: A tiny dragon on your desk
trending.promptText: A tiny fluffy dragon the size of a hamster sleeping on a cluttered office desk, soft morning light, photorealistic macro shot.

trending.title: Roast my fridge
trending.description: Honest feedback on your life choices, plus dinner.
trending.promptText: I will list what is in my fridge. Rate my life choices based on it, then suggest one dinner I can actually make tonight.

trending.title: Your 90s yearbook photo
trending.promptText: A 1990s high school yearbook portrait of [describe yourself], soft studio lighting, laser beam background, slight film grain.
